description: Search thousands of Dubai residential projects (DLD-registered plus MRK-researched new launches). Filter by community, developer, stage, handover year, starting-price range, bedrooms and type. Returns compact summaries with canonical URLs.

community.description: Community name or slug, e.g. 'Dubai Hills Estate' or 'business-bay'

developer.description: Developer name or slug, e.g. 'Emaar' or 'sobha-realty'

maxPriceAed.description: Maximum developer starting price in AED

minPriceAed.description: Minimum developer starting price in AED (projects without a price are excluded when set)

query.description: Free text matched against name, developer, community and summary

name: search_projects
title: Search Dubai projects
